top.name: Spot BTC ETF creation/redemption and AP inventory pressure
top.why_exists: Authorized participants and ETF issuers must create/redeem shares against underlying BTC (or cash-equivalent baskets). Large net creations force buy pressure in BTC spot/perp; redemptions force sell pressure. Flow is lumpy, predictable around NAV windows and settlement, not continuous free-float trading.
top.who_creates: Authorized participants (APs), ETF issuers (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, …), institutional allocators, market makers facilitating creations
top.why_not_arbed_immediately: Creation/redemption has operational lag, AP capital and inventory constraints, primary-market hours, and risk of adverse selection around NAV. Secondary ETF price can diverge from NAV short-term; arb requires inventory and is capacity-limited. Post-2024 spot ETFs introduced a large new structural channel not present in pre-ETF free OHLCV history.
observables: daily net ETF flows (USD and BTC)
lagged flow aggregates (T+0 published often with lag)
